owner_and_capability: Timetable & Activities — slice S5 of #3424 (#3551): the planner reads, the operational day, the retention cleanup, the ended-session completion and the planning-track administration leave modules/timetable/legacy/timetableplanning and become the public contracts timetable.TimetableDataCapability, timetable.OperationCapability, timetable.TimetableCleanup, timetable.EndedSessionCompletion and timetable.PlanningTrackAdministration, implemented in modules/timetable/compose
atomic_cutover: One PR moves the five capabilities to the owner and retires the three keys with them. The Änderungsprotokoll read of api/timetable/deviation_history.go receives the owner's typed rows instead of models/audit rows, which removes the last production import of models/audit from api/timetable. The operations handler tests lose the education group repository fake together with the moved operations code, which removes the last internal-test import of models/education from api/timetable; the ported behaviour tests live in modules/timetable/compose/httpintegration. The enrollment arrival-projection test builds the owner's planner reads through modules/timetable/compose instead of the nest's TimetableDataService, so it no longer constructs the education group repository and the external-test import of database/repositories/education disappears. HTTP paths, status codes, error texts, payloads, permissions and tenant scoping stay the same; the only visible change is that requireWebAttendanceForActiveInstance answers an unknown block with 404 instead of 500. No second provider, no fallback and no new debt key is added.

services/enrollment/timetable_arrival_projection_test.go builds the owner's planner reads and asserts the unchanged arrival projection in booking mode.
